producer_report.summary: The verifier now hears, in its prompt and its brief, that records/, private files and history are absent from its snapshot by design, and that their absence is not a finding. The prompt sentence follows producer.md; the brief sentence is in the '## The change' paragraph of verifier_brief. A unit test asserts the brief statement, and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased/Fixed records the root cause (the prompt named the absent paths without saying their absence was expected, and the brief did not mention them). The first version pushed the verifier role set over its 1300-token budget, so I trimmed other wording in verifier.md to pay for it; the rules are unchanged. fmt, clippy and the full locked test suite pass on the final tree. The watchdog and the deadline are not part of this change.

open_issues: The change capability's own verifier prompt (crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md) and the study capability's (crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/verifier.md) were not checked or edited. They are outside the deliverables list. If they also need the statement, that is a follow-up.
The role budget is nearly full, so any future verifier prompt addition needs a removal of about the same size.

The lib.rs test that pins verifier.md wording was not extended to pin the new statement. lib.rs is outside the deliverables, so the new wording is pinned only by the briefs.rs test (which covers the brief, not the prompt).
mistakes: My first verifier.md edit pushed the verifier role set over its 1300-token budget and failed every_role_set_is_within_its_budget. I found it on the full run and fixed it by trimming wording in verifier.md. I did not run the budget test before the first full run; I should have.

The trims rewrote the sentence about how Athena matches cited commands ('matches ... inside the commands you ran' became 'counts the criterion unmet unless it saw each cited command run'). The rule is the same, but the wording changed; the verifier should read it as equivalent.
learnings: The verifier's always-loaded set (contract, verifier frame, and the change capability's verifier section) has a 1300-token budget, estimated as ceil(bytes/3). It is near full: a one-sentence addition to verifier.md pushed it over, so the wording had to be paid for with removals.

crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs test the_verifier_frame_limits_snapshot_runs_to_the_snapshot pins the exact phrase 'no records/, no owner files, no history' in verifier.md, so that phrase cannot be reworded.

crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md and crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/verifier.md are separate capability prompts, so the verifier's wording is split between the frame and each capability section.
The verifier brief's '## The change' paragraph is where the statement lives; the producer brief already had its equivalent in '## Working directory'.
desires: A way to read long test output saved outside the working directory. The Grep and Read hooks refuse paths outside the working directory, so I could not open the saved full test log and had to rerun in quiet mode.
A budget report that says how many tokens are left in each role set before an edit, so a prompt addition can be paid for in the same pass.
